UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd raft && wget -q -N https://dl.winehq.org/wine/wine-mono/10.4.1/wine-mono-10.4.1-x86.msi && export WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all && /usr/bin/wine msiexec /i wine-mono-10.4.1-x86.msi /qn /norestart /log \"$WINEPREFIX/mono_install.log\""

/C if exist "{{$FullBaseDir}}RaftDedicatedServer.exe" (echo RaftDedicatedServer.exe found) else (echo RaftDedicatedServer.exe not found. Download it from master.raftmodding.com, upload it with the File Manager into the top folder next to Raft.exe, then start the server & exit /B 1)

-c "if [[ -f \"{{$FullBaseDir}}RaftDedicatedServer.exe\" ]]; then echo 'RaftDedicatedServer.exe found'; else echo 'RaftDedicatedServer.exe not found. Download it from master.raftmodding.com, upload it with the File Manager into the top folder next to Raft.exe, then start the server'; exit 1; fi"
